info.name: E-Commerce API
info.description:
Functional and security checks for the e-commerce REST API.

The folders are meant to run in order with one cookie jar: anonymous access, authentication, then the signed-in folders. Run with Newman (see the README).

item.name: 1. Access control: anonymous user
item.description: Runs first, before any login, so the cookie jar is empty. Every protected endpoint must answer 401.
